controls_and_limits: Same correct public schema facts and identical private token/global positions under two equivalent row orders. All 144 contexts cover both source owner assignments, two worlds and two orders.

All cross-source private prefill edges removed at every intended layer; all query tokens exclude public schema, and own query also excludes every foreign-source position. HEAD precedes schema and cannot relay it.
Whole source-owned K/V at all layers and all private positions are selected from same-world donors; HEAD/schema storage is order0, while schema keys are unread by query.
Own-only coherent-minus-mixed is an algebraic identity; its zero is an implementation control, not a scientific double dissociation.
Paired 2x2 joint contrast removes additive single-cache quality differences but does not distinguish binding coordinates from other nonadditive KV/attention/position/lexical contextualization.
No first claim about generic KV context dependence or cache noncomposability, no independent program/module/ID identification.

boundaries: Same correct public schema facts and identical private token/global positions under two equivalent row orders. All 144 contexts cover both source owner assignments, two worlds and two orders.

All cross-source private prefill edges removed at every intended layer; all query tokens exclude public schema, and own query also excludes every foreign-source position. HEAD precedes schema and cannot relay it.
Whole source-owned K/V at all layers and all private positions are selected from same-world donors; HEAD/schema storage is order0, while schema keys are unread by query.
Own-only coherent-minus-mixed is an algebraic identity; its zero is an implementation control, not a scientific double dissociation.
Paired 2x2 joint contrast removes additive single-cache quality differences but does not distinguish binding coordinates from other nonadditive KV/attention/position/lexical contextualization.
No first claim about generic KV context dependence or cache noncomposability, no independent program/module/ID identification.
Primary both averages 2 worlds x 2 Actors x 8 queries per context, not probability of jointly correct A and B.
Entire private cache composition and graph controls do not hold activations or attention strength fixed; public row order can change positions, KV norm or lexical salience.
Own-only paired zero is algebraic; coherent-vs-mixed joint interaction cancels additive single-cache quality but does not identify binding coordinates.
No new benchmark from new names/contexts, no complete source program, no native necessity beyond already tested E120 operation, no generic first KV compatibility claim.

scientific_update.scope: Functional compatibility of complete private Source caches formed under information-equivalent public row orders in the far-word task; no identified ID or abstract private-program composition.
limitations: All three confirmed both/A/B/private/opposite/same full primary effects positive; candidate effects small, only Qwen/Mistral CI strictly positive.
Own-only balanced zero is an implementation identity; independent private capabilities are strong but incomplete in some directions.
Qwen and Mistral joint order11-minus00 full accuracy negative with CI below zero; margin primary Qwen/Mistral negative point estimates and CI cross zero.
Joint coherent accuracy remains below own-only and native baselines; mean is not joint success.

Full accuracy is nonlinear in logits: the paired interaction cancels additive accuracy quality but can arise under competitive/additive score components; it does not identify a nonadditive latent binding representation.
Distinct output spaces are still a material explanation; far coherence alone does not demonstrate private mapping selection under shared words.
